{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel values
sentinel_values = [-999.0, -999, -999.00, -999.000]

# Create a boolean mask for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
is_sentinel = df['biomarker_baseline'].isin(sentinel_values)

# Cross-tabulate sentinel presence by sex
sentinel_by_sex = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], is_sentinel)
print(sentinel_by_sex)

# Calculate the proportion of sentinel values by sex
prop_sentinel_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].apply(lambda x: x.isin(sentinel_values).mean())
print(prop_sentinel_by_sex)"}
